description: Change the lot's community category (Residential, Money, Services, Welcome, Games, Entertainment, Romance, Shopping, Skills, Offbeat). DataService field sync, not a VMNet command. Category affects bonus objects the lot may host and its eligibility for community-payout features.
call_signatures: cf $CF lot-set-category   # SCAFFOLD op — not yet implemented; handler may return ok:false or a stub. Prefer a concrete sibling op if your goal is actionable.
common_mistakes: This is a SCAFFOLD op — the convention is declared but the handler may be unimplemented or stubbed. Check the declaration's status field.
Relying on scaffold ops mid-run will either return a deferred marker or fail — prefer a concrete sibling op, and file an rd item if the missing behaviour blocks progress.
